description: This file is a PHP test bootstrap script for a Goteo web application. It sets up test data, defines functions to create and delete test nodes, users, projects, investments, metrics, and other domain objects used in testing the application.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the system, includes methods for retrieval, saving, and deletion.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a network node or endpoint, with methods to get and delete nodes.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Represents a project, with methods to create, save, rebalance, retrieve, and delete projects.

classes.name: Invest
classes.description: Represents an investment, with methods for database insertion, retrieval, and deletion.

classes.name: Matcher
classes.description: Represents a matcher entity, with insert, get, and delete methods.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Represents a reward associated with projects.

classes.name: ImpactData
classes.description: Contains impact data for metrics or analytics.

classes.name: ImpactItem
classes.description: An impact item with attributes like name, description, and unit.

methods.name: get_test_node
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a test node with a specific ID.

methods.name: delete_test_node
methods.description: Deletes the test node with ID 'testnode' if it exists.

methods.name: get_test_user
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a test user with specific ID.

methods.name: delete_test_user
methods.description: Deletes the test user with the predefined ID.

methods.name: get_test_project
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a test project with specific ID.

methods.name: delete_test_project
methods.description: Deletes the test project with ID '012-simulated-project-test-210'.

methods.name: get_test_invest
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a test investment.

methods.name: delete_test_invest
methods.description: Deletes all test investments for the test user.

methods.name: get_test_matcher
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a test matcher object.

methods.name: delete_test_matcher
methods.description: Deletes the test matcher with ID 'test'.

methods.name: get_test_reward
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a test reward.

methods.name: delete_test_reward
methods.description: Deletes the test reward with ID 1.

methods.name: get_test_footprint
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a test footprint.

methods.name: delete_test_footprint
methods.description: Deletes the test footprint with ID 1.

methods.name: get_test_impact_data
methods.description: Creates or retrieves impact data record.

methods.name: get_test_impact_item
methods.description: Creates an impact item with predefined data.
